WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO created_computers 
    (computer_name, inventory_number, serial_number, fog_host_id, glpi_data, status, prepared_at)
  SELECT 
    '{{ $json.computer_name }}', 
    '{{ $json.inventory_number }}', 
    '{{ $json.serial_number }}', 
    {{ $json.fog_host_id }}, 
    to_jsonb('{{ $json.glpi_data_json }}'::json), 
    '{{ $json.status }}', 
    NOW()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM created_computers WHERE serial_number = '{{ $json.serial_number }}'
  )
  RETURNING id, computer_name, inventory_number, serial_number, fog_host_id, glpi_data, status
)
SELECT * FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT id, computer_name, inventory_number, serial_number, fog_host_id, glpi_data, status 
FROM created_computers 
WHERE serial_number = '{{ $json.serial_number }}' 
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted);

parameters.query:
SELECT entity_type, glpi_id, normalized_name 
FROM glpi_cache;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(inventory_number, 4) AS INTEGER)), 0) as max_sequence_today
FROM created_computers 
WHERE inventory_number LIKE '6' || to_char(NOW(), 'FMMMDD') || '%';

SELECT 
  {{ $json.glpi_computer_id }}::integer AS glpi_computer_id,
  {{ $json.postgres_id }}::integer AS postgres_id,
  COALESCE((glpi_data::jsonb -> '_component_ids' ->> 'processor')::integer, 0) AS processor_id,
  COALESCE((glpi_data::jsonb -> '_component_ids' ->> 'memory')::integer, 0) AS memory_id,
  COALESCE((glpi_data::jsonb -> '_component_ids' ->> 'storage')::integer, 0) AS storage_id
FROM created_computers 
WHERE id = {{ $json.postgres_id }};

SELECT 
  EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM created_computers 
    WHERE serial_number = '{{ $json.serial_number }}'
      AND status = 'created'
  ) AS is_duplicate,
  '{{ $json.serial_number }}' AS serial_number;
